blockers.required_resolution: Use an App Store provisioning profile with production push entitlement and get-task-allow=false.

blockers.required_resolution: Create a production-clean native release target/profile with dev-client/dev-menu excluded from the App Store archive.

blockers.title: Paid digital access and native IAP readiness are unresolved
blockers.evidence: Public App Store description states paid digital access is not available in iOS build until IAP is implemented and approved; native replacement audit still contains commerce/provider fallback areas.

blockers.title: Privacy manifest is not release-complete
blockers.evidence: PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declares an empty NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypes array while the app includes auth, messaging, uploads, notifications, and commerce-adjacent surfaces.

blockers.required_resolution: Run and document the full physical-device release matrix on the production-signed build.

blockers.evidence: app.json, Xcode project, assets, live audit/report, and security ledger changes were dirty before the release attempt.

blockers.evidence: Expo app version is 0.1.0 while Xcode marketing version is 1.0 build 1 and live App Store version is 1.0.

blockers.title: App Store Connect listing, metadata, build train, and IAP state were not accessible
blockers.evidence: No App Store Connect API credentials or authenticated Apple tooling were available in the environment.
blockers.required_resolution: Verify App Store Connect ownership, agreements, IAP products, privacy answers, screenshots, and build train before upload.
